name: Finland

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.applies: all visa-required nationalities, 12 years and older
fees.notes: Common Schengen fee, confirmed on the Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs 2026 fee decree page. Children 6-11 pay EUR 45; children under 6, EU-citizen family members (Directive 2004/38/EC) and certain students/researchers are exempt. Covers tourism and business purposes alike.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Schengen C visa and fee as tourist; purpose declared on application. No separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.applies: nationalities subject to airport transit visa requirement
fees.notes: Airport transit visas carry the same EUR 90 Schengen fee under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Finland does not issue short-stay e-visas. Applications are lodged at missions/VFS centres; the finlandvisa.fi portal is for forms and checklists only. (Finland's long-stay D visa has an electronic-application fee of EUR 95 vs EUR 120 on paper, but D visas are long-term and out of scope.)

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Finland does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained in advance (exceptional border visas only in emergencies, per Schengen rules).

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (upcoming, for visa-exempt nationals)
fees.notes: ETIAS is not yet in operation as of this record date; the EU has published a planned EUR 20 fee (free under 18 / over 70), but since it is not yet chargeable the amount is left null.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (EUR 70 for accelerated processing for Ukraine/Belarus). Source: https://um.fi/service-fees
Cabo Verde facilitation-agreement rate per um.fi service fee list.
EU-Russia visa facilitation is suspended; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 fee (Finland also heavily restricts Russian tourist visa issuance).
Standard Schengen fee; no facilitation agreement. USA, GBR and CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short stays.

vfs.note: Finland outsources visa intake to VFS Global in most non-EU countries (e.g. India, China, Nigeria, UK). VFS confirms a taxed service charge on its official Finland pages but publishes the exact amount only in the appointment/one-pager flow; third-party trackers put India centres at roughly INR 1,900-3,100 after the Nov 2025 increase. Amount varies by centre and country - verify on the local VFS Finland page before applying.

free_visa_notes: Visa fee waived for children under 6, family members of EU/Finnish citizens under Directive 2004/38/EC, holders of diplomatic/service passports on official visits, and case-by-case for school/study trips, researchers and young non-profit event participants.
